description.translate: Eight pieces of andesite alloy should restore the casings around the assembly bench. Wood gives it shape; alloy protects the fittings. Simple work, done properly. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

There. Voss's assembly marks identify the apparatus used to test the sword's captured Warden call. Prepared metal and sound machinery made the experiment possible. The failed coupling shows where a stronger vibration exceeded what that machinery could safely contain.
